messages:
Alex M: Heads-up — SorreL (on‑prem) runbook review needed. Proposing Wed Apr 8 16:00 PDT for the customer preflight call. Need infra, network, security, and CS on the line. Quick agenda draft below. Who can make that slot? :calendar:

Priya K: I can take it. Can we add DB team for migration window questions? Also please share pre-reads 24h before. :thumbsup:

Chen Li: I can join. Can someone paste the expected CIDR ranges and NAT details? I want to validate our firewall rules against customer config.

Sarah B: Adding security asks — need KMS/HSM details, TLS cert fingerprints, and expected audit log retention. Customer said they might use their KMS in the VPC.

Jamal R: I will run the runbook walkthrough and cover rollback playbook. I'll also prepare a short demo of the bootstrap script. Pls point me at the latest runbook link.

Alex M: Draft agenda (short):
```
1) Intros & roles (5m)
2) Customer environment summary + network CIDRs (10m)
3) Infra readiness & bootstrap demo (15m)
4) Security/KMS & certs (10m)
5) Migration window, canary, rollback plan (10m)
6) Action items + next steps (10m)
```
Can we keep it to 60m. If DB needs extra time we can spin a follow-up.

Chen Li: CIDRs from customer (copied from their note): 10.22.0.0/16, 172.31.0.0/16. They also listed a NAT subnet: 10.22.255.0/24. I'll sanity-check our iptables rules before the call.

Priya K: Pre-reads: runbook + bootstrap script + network diagram. Link: https://redwood.s3/runbooks/sorrel-onprem-v1.2.pdf (please review pages 4-9)

Sarah B: Customer will use AWS KMS with an external key policy. Need to confirm our IAM role ARN allowed to decrypt. Also confirm we capture CloudTrail logs to their S3 bucket — add to checklist.

Jamal R: Prep checklist I'll cover on call:
- runbook walkthrough (w/ failure scenarios)
- bootstrap demo (5m)
- canary plan (two-node canary, 30m window)
- rollback steps and artifact verification

Alex M: I'll send calendar invite once we lock attendees. Confirmed so far: Priya, Chen, Sarah, Jamal, and customer success (cc: @cs-team). Any other owners to add?

Priya K: Please add DB: @maria-db (she'll handle migration sequencing). Also include SRE oncall for the rollout day — @oncall.

deploy-bot: Calendar invite created: SorreL on‑prem preflight — Wed Apr 8 16:00 PDT. Invite sent to Alex M, Priya K, Chen Li, Sarah B, Jamal R, maria-db, cs-team.

Alex M: Great — final ask: everyone add a one-line preflight risk note in the doc before EOD tomorrow. I'll compile and send to the customer as part of the pre-read package. :eyes:
